# Every tool is a package of the go command. 'go tool' runs it there
# and never builds a tool from source.

go tool -n test2json
stdout 'tool test2json$'
! stdout 'pkg[/\\]tool[/\\]'

go tool test2json
stdout '{"Action":"start"}'

go tool -n nm
stdout 'tool nm$'
go tool -n pprof
stdout 'tool pprof$'
go tool -n objdump
stdout 'tool objdump$'
go tool -n addr2line
stdout 'tool addr2line$'
go tool -n buildid
stdout 'tool buildid$'
go tool -n pack
stdout 'tool pack$'
go tool -n trace
stdout 'tool trace$'

# The go command answers a tool's path with itself.
go tool -n compile
stdout 'tool compile$'

# A tool that is not a package of the go command and not declared in go.mod does not exist, and nothing builds it.
! go tool nosuchtool
stderr 'go: no such tool "nosuchtool"'
